sounds.title: vvv — letter-sound /v/ (scratchy ×4)
sounds.context: Voiced labiodental fricative. Rejected twice: schwa-tail (və, round-1) and length-mark+rate-20%+vol-12% (vːə, round-2). Residual = hard buzzy onset.

variants.label: Variant 0 — current live render
variants.mechanism: Production renderSsmlInnerText (vːə + rate-20% + vol-12%). The REJECTED baseline.
variants.ssml: [production renderSsmlInnerText for "Which letter says vvv?" @ tier=letter-sounds]

variants.label: Deep volume cut
variants.mechanism: vːə phoneme, rate-15%, volume -35% — attack loudness directly, far past the rejected -12%.
variants.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-GB-OliviaNeural"><prosody pitch="+0Hz" rate="-10%" volume="+0%">Which letter says <prosody rate="-15%" volume="-35%"><phoneme alphabet="ipa" ph="vːə">vvv</phoneme></prosody>?</prosody></voice></speak>

variants.label: Pitch-lowered
variants.mechanism: Bare /v/ + ə tail, pitch -3st, volume -20% — a lower f0 voiced fricative buzzes less.
variants.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-GB-OliviaNeural"><prosody pitch="+0Hz" rate="-10%" volume="+0%">Which letter says <prosody pitch="-3st" rate="-15%" volume="-20%"><phoneme alphabet="ipa" ph="və">vvv</phoneme></prosody>?</prosody></voice></speak>

variants.label: Break-isolated + long run
variants.mechanism: 350ms lead break, vːː extra-long fricative, rate-30%, no volume cut — give the run-out room, isolate the onset.
variants.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-GB-OliviaNeural"><prosody pitch="+0Hz" rate="-10%" volume="+0%">Which letter says <break time="350ms"/><prosody rate="-30%"><phoneme alphabet="ipa" ph="vːːə">vvv</phoneme></prosody>?</prosody></voice></speak>

variants.label: Syllabic /v̩/
variants.mechanism: Syllabic consonant v̩ (no schwa) + pitch -2st + volume -25% — alternative IPA shape Olivia may render smoother.
variants.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-GB-OliviaNeural"><prosody pitch="+0Hz" rate="-10%" volume="+0%">Which letter says <prosody pitch="-2st" volume="-25%"><phoneme alphabet="ipa" ph="v̩ː">vvv</phoneme></prosody>?</prosody></voice></speak>

variants.label: Leading-schwa onset ramp
variants.mechanism: əv (schwa BEFORE the fricative) + rate-20% + volume -28% — ramp INTO the buzz instead of front-loading it.
variants.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-GB-OliviaNeural"><prosody pitch="+0Hz" rate="-10%" volume="+0%">Which letter says <prosody rate="-20%" volume="-28%"><phoneme alphabet="ipa" ph="əvː">vvv</phoneme></prosody>?</prosody></voice></speak>

variants.label: Soft + deep, no length mark
variants.mechanism: Plain /v/ (no length mark), rate-25%, pitch -2st, volume -30% — let prosody do all the smoothing, not the IPA.
variants.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-GB-OliviaNeural"><prosody pitch="+0Hz" rate="-10%" volume="+0%">Which letter says <prosody pitch="-2st" rate="-25%" volume="-30%"><phoneme alphabet="ipa" ph="v">vvv</phoneme></prosody>?</prosody></voice></speak>

sounds.title: O — letter NAME "oh" (weird pressure)
sounds.context: Isolated terminal letter NAME. Rejected twice: rate-12% (round-1), rate-18%+vol-8%+250ms break (round-2 — "weird pressure on O").

variants.label: Variant 0 — current live render
variants.mechanism: Production renderSsmlInnerText (250ms break + rate-18% + vol-8% on bare letter). The REJECTED baseline.
variants.ssml: [production renderSsmlInnerText for "Let's look. O." @ tier=letter-names]

variants.label: Plain unwrapped
variants.mechanism: No break, no prosody — let Olivia voice the bare letter natively. Tests whether the WRAP itself is the pressure.
variants.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-GB-OliviaNeural"><prosody pitch="+0Hz" rate="-10%" volume="+0%">Let's look. O.</prosody></voice></speak>

variants.label: Gentle: soft volume only
variants.mechanism: 200ms break + volume -14% ONLY (no rate change) — soften without the rate-slow that over-articulates the onset.
variants.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-GB-OliviaNeural"><prosody pitch="+0Hz" rate="-10%" volume="+0%">Let's look. <break time="200ms"/><prosody volume="-14%">O</prosody>.</prosody></voice></speak>

variants.label: Lower pitch + soft
variants.mechanism: 200ms break + pitch -2st + volume -12% — drop the f0 prominence that reads as "pressure", keep the rate natural.
variants.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-GB-OliviaNeural"><prosody pitch="+0Hz" rate="-10%" volume="+0%">Let's look. <break time="200ms"/><prosody pitch="-2st" volume="-12%">O</prosody>.</prosody></voice></speak>

variants.label: Phoneme-pinned /əʊ/
variants.mechanism: 250ms break + <phoneme əʊ> (the GOAT diphthong) + volume -10% — pin the letter-name vowel so Olivia stops clipping it.
variants.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-GB-OliviaNeural"><prosody pitch="+0Hz" rate="-10%" volume="+0%">Let's look. <break time="250ms"/><prosody volume="-10%"><phoneme alphabet="ipa" ph="əʊ">O</phoneme></prosody>.</prosody></voice></speak>

variants.label: Trailing decay break
variants.mechanism: 150ms lead break + rate-8% + a 120ms break AFTER the letter — let the vowel decay instead of being cut at the period.
variants.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-GB-OliviaNeural"><prosody pitch="+0Hz" rate="-10%" volume="+0%">Let's look. <break time="150ms"/><prosody rate="-8%">O</prosody>.<break time="120ms"/></prosody></voice></speak>

variants.label: Low + slow attack, no break
variants.mechanism: No lead break, pitch -3st + rate-10% + volume -16% — a gentle continuous onset rather than a break-then-stress.
variants.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-GB-OliviaNeural"><prosody pitch="+0Hz" rate="-10%" volume="+0%">Let's look. <prosody pitch="-3st" rate="-10%" volume="-16%">O</prosody>.</prosody></voice></speak>

sounds.title: "Four comes after three" (sounds like "for")
sounds.context: Mid-sentence de-stressed "Four" collapses to "for" on non-rhotic Olivia. Rejected twice: rate-18%+fɔːr (round-1), pitch+12%+rate-25%+fɔːr (round-2).

variants.label: Variant 0 — current live render
variants.mechanism: Production renderSsmlInnerText (250ms break + pitch+12% + rate-25% + fɔːr). The REJECTED baseline.
variants.ssml: [production renderSsmlInnerText for "Look. Four comes after three." @ tier=none]

variants.label: Non-rhotic /fɔː/
variants.mechanism: 250ms break + pitch+10% + <phoneme fɔː> (NO rhotic r — the actual en-GB realisation Olivia can voice).
variants.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-GB-OliviaNeural"><prosody pitch="+0Hz" rate="-10%" volume="+0%">Look. <break time="250ms"/><prosody pitch="+10%" rate="-15%"><phoneme alphabet="ipa" ph="fɔː">Four</phoneme></prosody> comes after three.</prosody></voice></speak>

variants.label: Centring diphthong /fɔə/
variants.mechanism: <phoneme fɔə> centring diphthong + pitch+8% — more vowel body than a flat long-O, distinct from "for".
variants.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-GB-OliviaNeural"><prosody pitch="+0Hz" rate="-10%" volume="+0%">Look. <break time="200ms"/><prosody pitch="+8%"><phoneme alphabet="ipa" ph="fɔə">Four</phoneme></prosody> comes after three.</prosody></voice></speak>

variants.label: Pitch-contour rise
variants.mechanism: Stepped <prosody contour> (rise to +18% mid-word) + fɔː + rate-18% — a moving f0 contour reads as deliberate number-naming, not flat de-stressed "for".
variants.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-GB-OliviaNeural"><prosody pitch="+0Hz" rate="-10%" volume="+0%">Look. <break time="250ms"/><prosody contour="(0%,+8%) (50%,+18%) (100%,+6%)" rate="-18%"><phoneme alphabet="ipa" ph="fɔː">Four</phoneme></prosody> comes after three.</prosody></voice></speak>

variants.label: Hard isolation (pre+post break)
variants.mechanism: 300ms break BEFORE + 150ms break AFTER "Four" + pitch+12% — fully isolate the word so it carries its own stress island.
variants.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-GB-OliviaNeural"><prosody pitch="+0Hz" rate="-10%" volume="+0%">Look.<break time="300ms"/><prosody pitch="+12%" rate="-20%"><phoneme alphabet="ipa" ph="fɔː">Four</phoneme></prosody><break time="150ms"/> comes after three.</prosody></voice></speak>

variants.label: Bare stress, no phoneme
variants.mechanism: NO phoneme — just pitch+14% + rate-15% + volume+6% on the lexicon word. Tests if prominence alone picks the number reading.
variants.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-GB-OliviaNeural"><prosody pitch="+0Hz" rate="-10%" volume="+0%">Look. <break time="250ms"/><prosody pitch="+14%" rate="-15%" volume="+6%">Four</prosody> comes after three.</prosody></voice></speak>

variants.label: Long /fɔːː/ + steep rise
variants.mechanism: Extra-long <phoneme fɔːː> + steep pitch rise (+16%) + rate-22% — maximal length AND prominence past the rejected -25%/+12%.
variants.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-GB-OliviaNeural"><prosody pitch="+0Hz" rate="-10%" volume="+0%">Look. <break time="280ms"/><prosody pitch="+16%" rate="-22%"><phoneme alphabet="ipa" ph="fɔːː">Four</phoneme></prosody> comes after three.</prosody></voice></speak>
